purpose: Staging model for CYNIC public projection validation before production relay.

strategy.reference: industry standard: main → staging → production pipeline
strategy.decision: staging as validation environment, not public-facing branch

staging.purpose: integration testing, validation before release tag
notes: May be internal-only or limited public for review

production.deployment_trigger: release tag creation after gates pass
notes: Production relay to GitHub only on validated release tags
GitHub relay is projection, not authority

public_projection.rationale: Corporate front: public sees validated releases only, not staging work
public_projection.staging_visibility: private forgejo branch or limited review access

merge_to_main.from: agent branch PR merged to forgejo/main

release_consideration.action: create release tag vX.Y.Z on forgejo/main

rules.rule: Staging environment is private or limited-access, not public-facing.
notes: Public projection sees only validated production releases
Staging may be internal-only for integration validation

rules.rule: Production public projection (GitHub) receives releases only from validated release tags.
notes: No direct deployment from main to public projection
Release tag is the gate between staging validation and public visibility

rules.rule: Public projection maintains corporate-friendly surface: README, badges, release notes, clean history.
notes: No cypherpunk jargon in public README
Release notes readable by recruiters and external reviewers
GitHub main reflects validated production state
